## Test specifications

| Test spec | Stimulus | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-SPI-001.T1 | Build the board and observe the public SPI binding for this enabled child. | The child is bound to its parent controller at the reg chip-select index and to the corresponding cs-gpios specifier, if present. |
| ADV-SPI-002.T1 | Build the board and collect all public SPI child bindings for this controller. | Their count and chip-select values equal the enabled child nodes and reg values in the DTB. |
| ADV-SPI-003.T1 | Select one child and exchange a known byte while the child returns a distinct response byte. | The child observes the transmitted byte once and the controller receives the response from that same exchange. |
| ADV-SPI-004.T1 | Attempt exchange before selection, then select the addressed child, exchange one byte, deselect it, and attempt another exchange. | Only the exchange between select and deselect succeeds and the child observes select, byte, and deselect in that order. |
| ADV-SPI-005.T1 | Exchange one byte with a chosen virtual completion clock and inspect the transfer completion state and child event time. | Both completion state and the child exchange record the chosen clock after exactly one completed byte. |
| ADV-SPI-006.T1 | Build the board and observe public DMA resolution for every dmas tuple on this SPI controller. | The resolved provider and cells, tuple order, and dma-names entries equal the independently decoded DTB properties. |
